title_sq: AMBIENT KOMERCIAL PER SHITJE PRANE GJIMNAZIT PARTIZANI!
description_sq:
Ofrojme per shitje ambient komercial prane gjimnazit partizani dhe rruges se dibres.
Ambienti funksionon si bar dhe eshte i arreduar ne menyre bashkekohore dhe i kompletuar me te gjitha paisjet e nevojshme.
Aktualisht ne gjendje pune me nje xhiro te konsiderushme.
Ne perberje ka rreth 30 tavolina duke perfshire nje dubplex brenda ambientit dhe dy veranda te vogla.
Mos hezitoni te me kontaktoni per me shume informacion ose nje vizite ne prone.
title_en: COMMERCIAL ENVIRONMENT FOR SALE NEAR PARTIZANI HIGH SCHOOL!
description_en: We offer for sale commercial premises near the Partizani high school and Dibra road. The environment functions as a bar and is furnished in a contemporary manner and complete with all the necessary equipment. Currently in working condition with a considerable turnover. There are about 30 tables in the composition, including a duplex inside the room and two small verandas. Do not hesitate to contact me for more information or a visit to the property.
